issues.title: Store URL for icon for force, not data
issues.body:
Game Designers can use the admin pages to specify a logo for a force.

But, in the wargame document the data is stored as a base64 string,  not a URL.  Serge should store the icon on the server, and store a URL in teh 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124162100-0c39db80-da96-11eb-8ea0-f8ff5e1a58e5.png)


We should just have the iconURL for the force in the channel.

This fix involves both changing how the `admin pages` store the force icon, and how the `player pages` retrieve/display the icon.

* [ ] In TypeScript `force-data.d.ts` switch `icon` to `iconURL`
* [ ] In `Forces` tab, store icon to server, and store URL in wargame
* [ ] In player-UI, load icon from URL not base64 string
* [ ] Check above flow works when running application built with `yarn pkg-build` (to including assigning icon and display icon in UI)

Note: we should be backwards compatible.  Hmm, actually...  We don't need to display a icon if it's stored in `base64`, but the app shouldn't crash.

Note: once we have a working version, we'll need to check that the `pkg-build` version works (and stores/retrieves the icon correctly). @lebaphi is the expert on `pkg-build`.
Note: an image to use for testing can be found in: `packages\client\public\images\layers-2x.png`
